shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && ls src 2>/dev/null; ls app pages src/app src/pages 2>/dev/null; cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" && grep -rl "proxy.ts\|middleware.ts" node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js 2>/dev/null; grep -o "MIDDLEWARE_FILENAME[^;]*;\|PROXY_FILENAME[^;]*;" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js; grep -rn "deprecated" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js | grep -i "middleware" | head -5
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -sI http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i x-request-id; curl -sI http://localhost:3123/about | grep -i x-request-id; sleep 1; echo "--- server log ---"; grep -E "^\[" /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
git checkout tsconfig.json && cat .gitignore && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && git status --short
